prompt:

Notes / Add notes. Edit toolbar button.
Upper uses very subtle neutral frosted sidebar and toolbar control groups, quiet flat charcoal content. Lower uses visibly translucent floating sidebar with rounded edges, clear optical rim, subtle forest refraction, grouped floating glass toolbar with circular Add and Edit controls.
